description:
Review tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- create_video_review: Watch a rendered video and return a grounded quality verdict: a 0-100 score across six axes (hook, motion, fidelity, framing, on-brief, fini
- get_video_review: Fetch the result of a `create_video_review` submission.
- list_video_moments: Returns matching MOMENTS (time-slices) with a timecode ref, a relevance score, a text snippet and a thumbnail.

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).

name: review
title: Review
